title: 2.8 Count and Describe
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Build and understand number plus color plus noun phrases for one to six familiar items.
grammar_function: English adjective order number + color + noun; singular after one and regular plural -s after two or more. No There are yet.
speaking_outcome: Repeat six accurately ordered descriptive noun phrases, including singular and plural forms.
